# Documentation map

Which directory covers which topic. Read the pages under a directory before
changing behavior it describes, and update them in the same change.

| Topic | Where |
|---|---|
| Intro | `docs/docs/index.md` |
| Getting Started | `docs/docs/getting-started.md` |
| FAQ | `docs/docs/faq.md` |
| Contact | `docs/docs/contact.md` |
| Concepts | `docs/docs/concepts/` |
| Install | `docs/docs/install/` |
| Threeport Objects | `docs/docs/kubernetes-runtime/`, `docs/docs/machine/`, `docs/docs/workloads/`, `docs/docs/helm-workloads/`, `docs/docs/aws/`, `docs/docs/terraform/`, `docs/docs/gateways/`, `docs/docs/secrets/`, `docs/docs/observability/`, `docs/docs/control-planes/` |
| SDK | `docs/docs/sdk/` |
| Architecture | `docs/docs/architecture/` |
| Contributor docs | `docs/dev/`, build, test, release, SDK, and style guide |
| Design proposals | `docs/design/`, accepted designs not yet folded into the site |
